svg.title: Same 32 GB, very different price per gigabyte
svg.desc: Four 32 GB blower cards ranked by price per gigabyte of VRAM: B65 312, B70 594, RTX PRO 4500 969, RTX 5090 blower 1,656 yuan per GB. B65 is the floor of the four; the 5090 is 5.3x that.
svg.text: Same 32 GB, very different price per gigabyte
Longer bar = more expensive per GB; figures are October 2026 e-commerce list prices
B65's ¥312 is the floor of the four; the 5090 is 5.3x that, and its 575 W is 2.88x the B65's 200 W.
Prices are a single basis for cost-effectiveness comparison only; street prices move with platform discounts — check before ordering.
